title: ADORABLE and PERFECT
text:
ADORABLE and PERFECT. ADORABLE !! i just lost a kitty on Friday that looks just like this figurine .. I have a memorial table of all my furbabies and their ashes .. and each of them have a figurine on top of the urn that looks like them .. im ordering another one to keep it on my desk in here ... i still cant believe how i lost my beautiful molly girl (see pic) .. just terrible i hate cancer and she was so young i didnt even know until the last couple of weeks :(
UPDATE: this was my 2nd order .. just love it ...so well made too def worth the price !
